method.baseline: Every runtime quest × levels 1/3/5/8 × none/ordinary/strong gear × two compositions × three seeds; each session starts fresh with full HP/Armor/innate Ward. No ritual in baseline. Five-second simulation steps; presentation consumed by deterministic deadline fallback.

gear.ordinary: Least expensive compatible Head and Body items
gear.strong: Highest-price compatible item in each supported slot

method.ritual: Paired same-seed ordinary-gear runs for ten queued ritual effects, three levels, two compositions, five seeds, and the short/ghoul-hunt/pirate-boss contracts. Immediate healing/revival/exchange rituals are described and unit-tested separately.
limitations: Only two compositions; duplicate-class parties and party-order permutations are not covered.
Only three seeds per baseline composition; strata have six observations, not statistically precise win-rate estimates.
Gear is supplied for free in audit setup; quest rewards are not acquisition-cost-adjusted profit.
No repeated-campaign attrition, resting downtime or human choices are modeled.
No user saves are read or written.
Balanced-looking aggregate results can conceal individual quest/class problems.
No native hardware, monitor, audio or long soak acceptance is implied.

metricNotes.signatureEvents: Counts primary signature-labelled attack/heal/support events, including enemies and class support. It is not the per-player special-use ledger.
metricNotes.wounds: Counts returning members whose final condition is Wounded; not the number of permanent wound titles acquired.
metricNotes.clear: Final victory and no automatic retreat; a clear can still contain casualties.
metricNotes.gold: Coins actually settled; no equipment acquisition cost is deducted.
metricNotes.arcana: Arcana settled after activation; subtract activationCost to calculate the ritual run’s activation-adjusted Arcana return.
